title: iberis carnosa subsp. senneniana
intro: Iberis carnosa subsp. senneniana, commonly known as Sennen's Cress, is a plant species within the Brassicaceae family, known for its unique characteristics and medicinal properties. Research suggests that Sennen's Cress has various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit cytotoxic properties against certain pathogens. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified through phytochemical analysis.
